justification.title: Calculation Details
justification.growthExplanation: The growth rate of {{rate}}% was calculated considering {{eventsThisMonth}} events in the current month ({{currentMonth}}) relative to the total of {{totalEvents}} events.
justification.budgetExplanation: The average budget of {{average}}€ was calculated by adding the total budget amount ({{totalBudget}}€) and dividing by the number of events with a budget ({{eventsWithBudget}}).
justification.dayExplanation: {{day}} is the most frequent day of the week for events, representing {{percentage}}% of all events.
justification.categoryExplanation: The category {{category}} is the most frequent with {{count}} events out of a total of {{total}}, representing {{percentage}}% of all events.
justification.locationExplanation: The location {{location}} is the most frequent with {{count}} events out of a total of {{total}}, representing {{percentage}}% of all events.
justification.typeExplanation: {{type}} are the most common with {{count}} events out of a total of {{total}}, representing {{percentage}}% of all events.
justification.cancellationExplanation: The cancellation rate of {{rate}}% was calculated considering {{cancelledParticipants}} participants who canceled relative to the total of {{totalParticipants}} participants.
justification.attendanceExplanation: The attendance rate of {{rate}}% was calculated considering {{attendedParticipants}} participants who attended relative to the total of {{totalParticipants}} participants.
justification.recurringExplanation: The recurrence rate of {{rate}}% was calculated considering {{uniqueRecurringParticipants}} participants who attended multiple events, out of a total of {{recurringParticipants}} recurring attendances.
